checks: On an old vertical column the threshold velocity is (r−ν·w)/|u|. At a proper section the relative interior lies in the body interior, and the relative boundary has zero section area. Fubini therefore gives Sr−m·ν with the full ambient moment. At strict full and empty fibers the old-body plane loss is zero, with whole-boundary and zero shell contributions respectively.

For inside support, the signed old-body and shell terms combine to v+[A−v]₊ with A=(r−ν·w)/|u|. For outside support they combine to −[A−v]₊ with A=(ν·w−r)/|u|. Checked these identities independently by intersecting the oriented interval between 0 and v with each half-line, including 25 exact rational pairs with both signs, zeros, and ties. Supporting sections of dimension below d−1 have zero surface area. In d=1 the section/endpoint measures are counting measures and the same interval formulas apply.

The proper-section boundary contributes no exceptional surface mass. The signed shell formula from the continuation applies with a dominated bounded integrand, and at a supporting plane the moving indicator has at most one exceptional scaled radial coordinate for each regular old boundary point. The argument persists along each bounded threshold-speed sequence with a convergent subsequence, which gives compact-uniform first-order convergence.

Both loss functions increase at least S times a positive threshold increment and are onto. Near the old thresholds, positive own proper coarea gives the uniform local inverse bound, and bounded total coarea gives a lower bound on the weighted inverse increment per unit mass. These bounds imply q_i(t)−Q=O(t) and c_j(t,q_i(t))−c_j=O(t). Taking limits in the compact-uniform expansion gives the unique equalized actual loss at the exact limiting contact budget.

At the same loss, R_j^0≤R_j gives (R_j^0)⁻¹≥R_j⁻¹, so a fixed weighted threshold budget gives ℓ_i^0≤ℓ_i. Every fixed linear branch gives the reverse inverse comparison against R_j^0 and hence majorizes its equalized loss. At the solved conservative thresholds the sign of the outside hinge chooses one measurable selector per cap, simultaneously attaining equality in all cap losses. Its contributions to b_j^θ, T_j and m_j^θ use the same θ_j. Budget monotonicity permits the finite minimum over contacts.
